name: gaps2-construction-te
description: Thunder's Edge Construction (pbd105, strategy_card_set te). Rules text: primary 'Either place 1 structure on a planet you control, or use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks. Place 1 structure on a planet you control.'; secondary 'Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place 1 structure on a planet you control.' So a second space dock (another planet) is LEGAL with this card (unlike Prophecy of Kings, gaps2-construction-two-docks). Naalu places docks on Qucenn and Maaluuk (both accepted), a third structure is refused; Ral Nel (follower) places 1 PDS, a second structure is refused.
